description: Provider-neutral asset receipt for one prompt-produced asset. The budget_decision is a CITATION of the one governing prompt policy (post Q1 ruling: the KIE rule-12 band), never a selection: it names the governing prompt_policy_id and cites that registry entry's entry_hash. Decision values are registry verdict strings only; layer-local exit codes are refused by the aggregator (collect_launch_receipts.validate_budget_decision), a rule this schema cannot express and therefore only records.

budget_decision.description: Citation of the governing policy: the verdict in the cited registry entry's decision_values, the governing prompt_policy_id, and that entry's entry_hash. A citation missing either the id or the hash is not acceptable to S49's aggregator.

prompt_artifact_path.description: Path of this item's prompt artifact as recorded in the producing page-result's artifacts; the aggregator requires this receipt's prompt_hash to equal that artifact's sha256.

provider_receipt_ids.description: Provider receipt identifiers if actually returned. An identifier the provider did not issue is recorded as absent (the key omitted, or null for kie_task_id), never fabricated. kie_task_id is recorded only where the KIE API actually returned one.

title: Prompt asset receipt (doc 02 section 10, Q11 / PP-T3)
